po_new: Expanded Revenue chart when there are no sales at all

When a location has no sales at all in the Revenue tile's range (for example an empty location on This Month) and you open the Revenue details, what should the chart show?
(a) The words "No data for selected date range", like the other expanded charts with nothing to show.
(b) An empty day-by-day chart (the axis and day labels, with no bars), because $0.00 is a real amount on Revenue.

The new rule for expanded charts says a chart "with nothing to show" reads "No data for selected date range". Another rule says a day with no sales is a real $0 on Revenue. We cannot tell which applies when every day is $0.00. One test case (C351708) waits on this.
